about.title: A welcoming space for DCMS alumni
about.paragraph1: The DCMSXF forum is a trusted community platform for former students. It is built to celebrate achievements, share important news, and keep the alumni network strong across batches and careers.
about.paragraph2: From reunion planning to professional introductions, this page brings the spirit of our alma mater into a modern, easy-to-navigate digital space.
about.trustText: Moderated discussions, verified event posts, and alumni-only networking keep the forum safe and meaningful.
about.heritageText: Celebrate school traditions, memories, and achievements while making new connections that last beyond graduation.
